subject.title: feat(mobile): default pairing to full node access

question: Should official mobile setup codes grant operator.admin only after exact native-client verification, with every other setup-token consumer failing closed?
rationale: The feature direction intentionally changes a credential boundary, and maintainers must confirm which clients may convert possession of the setup code into a persistent administrative credential after the concrete bypass is repaired.

options.title: Verified mobile only
options.body: Allow mobile-full redemption only for exact official iOS and Android metadata, rejecting all other consumers before silent pairing.

options.title: Keep bounded default
options.body: Retain limited operator access as the default and require an explicit user choice for administrative mobile access.

options.title: Accept local fallback
options.body: Permit generic local clients to redeem full setup tokens and explicitly document the broader local-network trust model.

recommendation.title: Verified mobile only
recommendation.body: Allow mobile-full redemption only for exact official iOS and Android metadata, rejecting all other consumers before silent pairing.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature and pairing history most directly associates this person with the intended mobile-access behavior and its authorization design.
